method: Each image individually inspected at native1024 with view_image, not just a contact sheet.
visual_observations: Both reconstructions preserve coherent eyes, mouth, clerical collar and source identity. CPU and MPS look indistinguishable at displayed native size. Source already has pronounced fine skin texture; reconstructions soften some of it and retain fine texture on cheeks and forehead. No backend-specific repeating mesh is visible.
conclusion: No evidence that MPS FP32 decoder numerical error explains generated-image mesh for this tested latent. CPU/MPS pixel differences are negligible; swapping decoder backend is not justified by this test.
limitations: One teacher posterior-mean reconstruction, not arbitrary generated latents.
Does not isolate learned VAE reconstruction texture from teacher texture.
Does not test CPU versus MPS UNet/scheduler denoising.
No upstream FP16 generated-latent quantization simulation.
Both arms use matched VAE tiling; no untiled comparison.
earlier_attempt: v1 stopped before encode due to runtime JSON PosixPath serialization; retained and fixed for this fresh v2 run.
